pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, feathered pixel-level edge gradients. The patches exhibit a high degree of shape variation and non-uniform spatial area as they transition from the neck to the shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-toned pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections with variable pixel thickness that narrows significantly at certain vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible against the white background. The 1D contour consists of low-amplitude, closely spaced serrations formed by the individual tufts of the mane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct dark avian organisms, likely oxpeckers, perched on the upper neck and shoulder region.
